content: Rawiri kemɨtiutaxatsie 'Ixaheritsie ti'aitame mayanikɨ
Merikɨtsɨ 'ixaheritsixi teɨteriya yunaitɨ Hewuruni mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni Rawiri hetsɨa, mana mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: «Tame meta 'ekɨ tepɨ'iwamarixi.

Meripaitɨri 'ekɨ, kepauka Tsahuri mɨti'aitametɨkaitsie, 'ekɨ pepɨwanɨ'akai 'ixaheritsixi memɨyukwitɨwekaitsie. Metatsiere Yawé Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ pɨmatiutahɨawixɨ: “'Ekɨ neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi pekaniwayewitɨmɨkɨ meta pekatiniwata'aitɨamɨkɨ”».

Merikɨte, yunaitɨ 'ukirawetsixi 'Ixaheritsie kiekatari mekanekɨne Hewuruni paitɨ Rawiri hetsɨa, hikɨ mɨkɨ mana tɨratu wahamatɨa kaniuwewieni Yawé hɨxie. Hikɨ 'ana Rawiri hatseiti mekanikawirieni, 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie ti'aitame mayanikɨ, Yawé kemainekai Tsamuheri kemɨrahɨawekai.
Rawiri Kerutsareme kemɨra'iwaxɨ
Merikɨtsɨ Rawiri meta yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi teɨteriyari mekanekɨne Kewutsi mɨrakutewatsie (tatsɨari Kerutsareme), mana kewutseutsixi mekanititekaitɨni.
Hikɨ Kewutsi kiekatari Rawiri mɨpaɨ mekateniutahɨawe: «Pepɨkayɨwe 'uwa pematahani». Peru Rawiri Kiekariena Tsiyuni yukuraru 'amatitewa mexeiyakai kana'iwa, metatsiere mumatiwa Rawiri kiekariena.

Rawiri mɨpaɨ pɨtiwarutahɨawekai yukuyaxima: «Kemɨ'ane meri kewutseu tewiyari mumieni xeime mɨkɨ kuyaxi wa'ukiyari kanayeimɨkɨ». 'Ana Kuhawi Tsariwiya nu'aya xeime kewutseu tewiyari kaniumieni, mɨkɨ kuyaxi wa'ukiyari kanayeitɨarieni.
Rawiri yukie kanayeitɨani mɨkɨ kiekari yukuraru 'amatitewa mexeiya, hikɨ 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ katinitewaka «Rawiri Kiekarieya».
Meta kiekari kaniutawewieni kwie meukawiwiyatsie 'itsutɨaka meta kiekari warita, meta Kuhawi Kerutsareme kiekariyari 'aixɨa kaniyurienekaitɨni.
Rawiri matsi waɨkawa tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kanayeiximekaitɨni, Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye hamatɨana muyeikakaikɨ.
Rawiri kuyaximama wa'ukiyarima

'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai Rawiri kuyaximama wa'ukiyarima, mɨkɨ mepiparewiekai kepauka mɨti'aitametɨkaitsie, 'ana yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi me'uyukuxeɨrieka ti'aitame mekaneyeitɨani 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie miemekɨ, meripaitɨ Yawé kemainekai 'Ixaheri hepaɨtsita.

'Ikɨ Rawiri kuyaximama mekanihɨkɨtɨni memaka'utɨarie yemekɨ memɨkamamakai: Yatsuwehani Kakumuni nu'aya, mɨkɨ matsi pɨhɨkɨtɨkai mexɨakame memuyuhaika memɨkamamakai, heiwa meyukwitɨwetɨ haika tsienituyari puwarukwi teɨteri yupitsikakɨ.
Hutarieka miemeta pɨhɨkɨtɨkai 'Eriyatsaxi Ruruhu nu'aya, 'Akuki nuiwarieya, mɨkɨtatsiere yemekɨ pɨkamakai peuyutamiewekai.
Rawiri hamatɨa Patsiramini kaniuyeikakaitɨni, hakewa piritsiteutsixi memeyukuxeɨriekai mewatakwinike. Manata tsewara pɨ'etsiekai, kepauka kuyaxi 'ixaheritsixi memuyuta'unaxɨ,
'Eriyatsaxi meta Rawiri tsewara mayema mekaniyuhayewa waheima mekaniutanuani piritsiteutsixi mekaniwarukwini. 'Ana Yawé kaniwarupitɨani memɨtehayu'iwakɨ.

Xeitewiyari heimana tamamata kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete, mɨkɨ meyuhaikatɨ, mekanekɨne mu'aiyatsiepaitɨ, Rawiri muwayekateitsie paitɨ 'Arurani terɨyarita paitɨ, piritsiteutsixi mayeweritsie Xepahini mekanikutekaitɨni.
'Ana Rawiri kaniyu'awietakaitɨni, 'anata Wereni kiekariyaritsie piritsiteutsixi mekanihɨkaitɨni.
Hikɨ Rawiri mɨyeharimɨnekaikɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Nemɨniyɨweniketɨ haa nemɨtiharenikɨ Wereni kitenieyaritsie mɨtiniere».

Hikɨ memuyuhaika memɨkamama piritsiteutsixi memakuteitsie me'uyekɨneka, Wereni haputsuyarita haa mekaniwatihana, hikɨ Rawiri mekanehanirieni. Peru Rawiri pɨka'enuhari, kanitayeurieni pɨta Yawé hetsiemieme,

mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Kakaɨyari hɨxie 'ikɨ haa nepɨka'anuhareni. Xɨka ne'enuhareni, memi'atɨa waxuriya nemanuhareni hepaɨ nepɨyɨni. Yutukari mepɨyetua kemɨ'ane haa memɨ'atɨa». Hikɨ 'ayumieme pɨka'enuhari. 'Ikɨ meyuhaikatɨ mɨpaɨ mepɨteyuriekai waɨkawa.
'Awitsahi Kuhawi 'iwaya, mɨkɨ memɨyuhaika katiniwa'aitɨwametɨkaitɨni, mɨkɨ 'aixɨa katinikuxaxatsiwakaitɨni. Mɨkɨ heiwa yupitsika hakwetɨ kaniyutamieni, haika tsienituyari teɨteri kaniwarukwini.
Mɨkɨ matsi waɨkawamekɨ kaniyɨwekaitɨni kuyakɨ keyuri memɨyuhaika, 'ana mɨkɨ muwanɨ'a kanayani, peru mɨkɨ wahamatɨa pɨka'u'inɨatsie.

Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya kuya pɨhɨkɨtɨkai Kawɨtseri kiekame. Mɨkɨ teɨteri yuhutame memeuyutakwiwawe pɨwarukwi Muhawi kiekatari, meta heiwa 'u'ɨwiyakaku putsu muyewakita heukahaka xeime maye kaniumieni.
Meta xeime 'ekipitutanaka huta meturuyari heimana 'imeriyu 'utewime kaniumieni, pitsika kanakwekaitɨni kwiniepame. Wenahiyaxi matsi kɨye xeikɨa pakwekai, pitsikaya kaninawairieni mɨkɨkɨ kanimieni.
Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya mɨpaɨ pɨtiyurienekai waɨkawa, mɨkɨta 'aixɨa tikuxaxatsiwatɨ patɨa memuyuhaika hepaɨ,
peru mɨkɨ wahamatɨa pɨka'u'inɨatsie, tsepa xeitewiyari heimana tamamata memuyupaɨme memɨkamama muwara'iwakai. Hikɨ 'ana Rawiri yuhɨwemete muwanɨ'a kaneyeitɨani.
'Ikɨ kuyaxi memɨyɨwawekai memɨkamamakai mekanihɨkɨtɨni: 'Atsaheri, Kuhawi 'iwaya, 'Erikanani Ruruhu nu'aya Wereni kiekame,
Tsamuti Haruri kiekame, Heretsi Peruni kiekame,
'Ira 'Iketsi nu'aya Tekuha kiekame, 'Awihetsexi 'Anatuti kiekame,
Tsiwekahi Kutsa kiekame, 'Irahi 'Akuki nuiwarieya hetsiemieme,
Marahi netupatanaka, Kereri Wanaha nu'aya Netupaha kiekame,
'Itahi Xiwahi nu'aya, Kiweha kiekame Wenikamini kwieyaritsie mɨti'ane, Wenahiyaxi Piratuni kiekame,
Kurahi Kahatsi 'akiyaritsie kiekame, 'Awiheri Weti-'Arawa kiekame,
'Atsimaweti Wakurini kiekame, 'Erihawa Tsariwini kiekame,
Katseni Kitsuni kiekame niwemama, Kunatani Tsakehe nu'aya 'Arari kiekame,
'Ahiyani Tsakaxi nu'aya 'Arari kiekame, 'Eripari 'Uxi nu'aya,
Hepexi Mekera kiekame, 'Ahiyaxi Peruni kiekame,
Ketsiru Kaximeri kiekame, Narahi 'Etsiwahi nu'aya,
Kuheri Natani 'iwaya, Miwaxi Hakɨri nu'aya,
Tsereki 'amuni tewiyari, Nakarahi Weruti kiekame Kuhawi hɨwemetɨkai Tsariwiya nu'aya,
'Ira 'itɨrita tewiyari, Karewi 'itɨrita tewiyari,
'Uriyaxi Heti tewiyari, Tsawari 'Akirahi nu'aya,
'Arinaha Tsitsaha nu'aya Xuweni nuiwarieya, xuwenitsixi muwanɨ'a pɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta xeitewiyari heimana tamamata teɨteri mekaneweiyakaitɨni.
Kanahani Mahaka nu'aya, Kutsapati Mitini kiekame,
'Utsiyaxi 'Atsitaruti kiekame, Tsama meta Kehieri Kutani niwemama 'Aruhexi kiekame,
Keriyaheri Tsimɨri nu'aya, meta 'iwaya Yuká Titsi kiekame,
'Eriheri Mahawa kiekame, Kerewahi meta Kutsawiyaxi 'Erinahani niwemama, 'Itimaha Muhawi tewiyari,
'Eriheri, 'Uweri meta Katsiheri Tsuwaha kiekame.
